name: open-loops
description: A board beside your Claude Code chat for what's still open: sessions waiting on you, tasks in a plain markdown file.

tasksFile.title: Tasks file
tasksFile.description: The markdown file that holds your tasks table, relative to your home folder (or absolute, or starting with ~/). Created with the table header when it does not exist.

me.title: Your name in the who column
me.description: Rows with this name are your own work (start button); any other name is someone you wait on (chase button). New rows get it when the text names nobody.

homeFolder.title: Home folder
homeFolder.description: The name of the folder you usually work in. Sessions there show no folder label; sessions elsewhere do. Empty labels every session.

doneLimit.title: Done rows shown
doneLimit.description: How many closed rows the Done column shows, newest first.

teachClaude.title: Teach Claude the tasks file
teachClaude.description: Adds a short note to Claude's instructions in every session: where the tasks file is, and that "task: ..." in a message means add a row. Turn off if your own CLAUDE.md already says this.
